about: Render targets for the workstation-ui simulator (/opt/workstation/lvgl-sim). Each target compiles REAL firmware UI sources from main/ plus a small adapter in tools/uisim/targets/ that turns fixture state into the same calls status_deck_ui.c makes. Fixture values are flat strings/ints/bools; 'fixtures' are named, realistic states. See tools/uisim/README.md.

voice_listening_widget.description: HOME's microphone: rotating outer ring with a travelling highlight, counter-rotating accent, inner ring, halo, navy disc, white mic. 172x172. Its colour/motion is the device's link indicator. Rendered alone, centred on a plain screen.

link.doc: backend reachability as the widget shows it: ok = spinning + white mic; down = stopped + red mic; no_net = stopped + grey mic; unknown = spinning + grey mic

notification_pending.doc: outer ring turns orange while a low-confidence notification waits

home.description: HOME as the device builds it today: the listening widget centred (ui_home.c) under the four 96x52 corner nav buttons (ui_kit.c), default light theme.

link.doc: backend_health state mapped the way voice_ui_timer_cb maps it

notification_pending.doc: notification_client says a low-confidence notification is waiting

firmware.description: FIRMWARE page (ui_firmware_page.c): version, build time, backend address, OTA slot and probation state, updater status line, CHECK CLAWBOX NOW button; HOME corner button only.

pending_verify.doc: image still on probation (health gate not passed)
